results.title: Sós
results.overview: A widow keeps her husband's memory alive through daily, silent gestures, until longing and love lead her to meet him again, in an ending where reality and affection merge.

results.title: La Muerte de un Comandante
results.overview: After the death of commander Diaz, investigators search for the perpetrators but keep discovering worse things.

results.title: Le grand retour des annulés
results.overview: Banished and then forgotten, the canceled are reappearing. Marie-France Bazzo conducts a clear-eyed investigation into this return: what does it reveal about our relationship to forgiveness, justice, and forgetting? Was it a necessary evil? How do we cancel… and reintegrate?

results.title: The Night Screening
results.overview: Watchmaker stumbles into a mysterious cinema and is enraptured by the sight of movie star Lisa sleeping on the screen. His life changes. A girl he meets in the cinema begins leading him through the strange world of cinematic dreams.

results.title: Money Tree
results.overview: While on a walk through the woods, Daniel, an overwhelmed college student, wishes for something that he believes will solve all of his problems.

results.title: A Brother and 7 Siblings
results.overview: After the untimely death of his older sister and her husband, a struggling young architect suddenly becomes a "single parent" for his nieces and nephews. When the opportunity for a better life arises, he must choose between his love life, career, or his family.

results.title: Borderline
results.overview: Ornithologist Vilius, trapped by guilt and loss, gets himself into a dangerous smuggling business,  unexpectedly, this criminal activity forces him to rethink his life and reconnect with his daughter.

results.title: Akshardham: Operation Vajra Shakti
results.overview: NSG commando Hanut Singh, scarred by a past mission, defies orders during a temple siege in Gujarat. He leads a risky operation against terrorists demanding a militant's release, while confronting personal demons.

results.title: Kairos
results.overview: Emma is an ambitious computer science student at the Academy of Advanced Technologies. When she develops Kairos, an artificial intelligence for her final project, she is unknowingly shaping the course of her own life, as it can generate statistical predictions to guide her in shaping her future… But at what cost?

results.title: Meat
results.overview: After a night of drugs and debauchery results in the fatal overdose of an underage gay man, an innocent bystander is left to take the blame. Upon his release from prison, the guilty party becomes the focus of an eccentric killers revenge.

results.title: Cycle of Time
results.overview: In 1950s France, Helene and Michel lead a simple life until a freak accident in 2025 leads to Helene becoming a bank executive and Michel struggling with unemployment and depression. Their children grow up in a technology-dominated world.

results.title: Geminate Flower
results.overview: It follows Jin and May as memory, friendship, and time intertwine, revealing how fading recollections reshape identity, deepen bonds, and transform the meaning of loss.

results.title: A Dance with Death
results.overview: A year after escaping a fatal masquerade ball, Nora gets death threats. When the stalker targets her mother instead, she must confront a killer determined to end her life.

results.title: Netflix Tudum 2025
results.overview: Celebrate your favorite shows and movies at this star-studded, live global fan event with special performances and exclusive reveals.

results.title: Pentest
results.overview: Nabil is set to deliver a meal inside the offices of a major bank, but the receptionist curtly denies him access. Moved by the young man's visible distress, a security guard opens a fire escape for him. Nabil slips deeper into the building's hidden depths.

results.title: Lost & Found in Cleveland
results.overview: A slice of life set over a 24-hour period that follows the personal odysseys of five very different people, whose lives intertwine when America’s favorite televised antiques appraisal show comes to Cleveland, "the best location in the nation".

results.title: Mother Wound
results.overview: A grandmother’s decline forces her daughter and granddaughter to address their own inter-generational divide.

results.title: Catch of the Day
results.overview: Sophie is a rising culinary star on the verge of becoming executive chef at a high-end Manhattan restaurant. But when her sister Abigail calls with news that their beloved family seafood spot in Montauk is floundering, Sophie returns home to help. What was meant to be a short visit turns into a journey of rediscovery, of her roots, her passion for cooking, and a surprising second chance at love with her teenage crush, Cam, a local fisherman whose quiet strength and charm leave Sophie rethinking everything she thought she wanted.
